title: Const-ify a selection of arrays of function pointers.
description:
These arrays are never written, and constitute another 21 kBytes of data which
can be moved from a read-write section to a read-only section.

commits_data.message:
Const-ify a selection of arrays of function pointers.

These arrays are never written, and constitute another 21 kBytes of data which
can be moved from a read-write section to a read-only section.
